## Reference

- [Reference](/reference/index.md): API-first reference for stores, hooks, middlewares, and integrations.
- [create](/reference/apis/create.md): How to create stores
- [createStore](/reference/apis/create-store.md): How to create vanilla stores
- [createWithEqualityFn](/reference/apis/create-with-equality-fn.md): How to create efficient stores
- [shallow](/reference/apis/shallow.md): How compare simple data effectively
- [useStore](/reference/hooks/use-store.md): How to use vanilla stores in React
- [useStoreWithEqualityFn](/reference/hooks/use-store-with-equality-fn.md): How to use vanilla stores effectively in React
- [useShallow](/reference/hooks/use-shallow.md): How to memoize selector functions
- [persist](/reference/middlewares/persist.md): How to persist a store
- [devtools](/reference/middlewares/devtools.md): How to time-travel debug your store
- [redux](/reference/middlewares/redux.md): How to use actions and reducers in a store
- [immer](/reference/middlewares/immer.md): How to perform immutable updates in a store without boilerplate code
- [combine](/reference/middlewares/combine.md): How to create a store and get types automatically inferred
- [subscribeWithSelector](/reference/middlewares/subscribe-with-selector.md): How to subscribe to granular store updates in a store
- [How to Migrate to v5 from v4](/reference/migrations/migrating-to-v5.md): We highly recommend to update to the latest version of v4, before migrating to v5. It will show all deprecation warnings without breaking your app.
- [Migrating to v4](/reference/migrations/migrating-to-v4.md)
- [createContext from zustand/context](/reference/previous-versions/zustand-v3-create-context.md)
- [Immer middleware](/reference/integrations/immer-middleware.md)
- [Persisting store data](/reference/integrations/persisting-store-data.md)
- [Third-party Libraries](/reference/integrations/third-party-libraries.md)
